contexts.title: Project Wicklow cutover decision log
contexts.text:
PROJECT WICKLOW - LOYALTY POINTS CUTOVER - DECISION LOG
Maintained by Joaquim Tell. Last updated Oct 2, after the go/no-go prep meeting.
Attendees (Oct 2): Nadia Ferreira-Kwan, Joaquim Tell, Farida Oyelowo, Ben Strand, Harriet Mbeki (support), Sol Ramires (product). Apologies: Dmitri.

DECISIONS
D1 (Sep 18) Owner. Migration owner and DRI for the cutover: Nadia Ferreira-Kwan. Backup if Nadia is unavailable: Joaquim Tell.
D2 (Sep 18) Scope. Points balances, earn rules and redemptions move to the new points service. Gift card balances are OUT of scope and stay on legacy until the gift card team signs off.
D3 (Sep 25) Code freeze on points-service, checkout and the mobile BFF starts Wed Oct 15 at 18:00 PT and lifts after the cutover retro.
D4 (Sep 25) Cutover window: Thu Oct 16, 22:00 to 02:00 PT.
D5 (Oct 2) Rollback criteria. Roll back if the redemption error rate stays above 1.5% for 10 consecutive minutes, or if p99 redemption latency stays above 1,200 ms for 15 minutes. Nadia makes the call; no further approval needed.
D6 (Oct 2) Legacy API. The v1 /points/balance endpoint stays up read-only for 21 days after cutover, then returns 410 Gone. Older app versions that still call it will show cached balances during that window.
D7 (Oct 2) Cart widget. The points widget on the web cart page ships behind the flag loyalty_cart_widget, default OFF. Turn it on for 5% of web traffic the Monday after cutover if the error budget allows. The mobile widget is deferred to Q1.
D8 (Oct 2) Cutover-night on-call: Farida Oyelowo primary, Ben Strand secondary. A P2 ticket with the database vendor is opened in advance.

ACTION ITEMS
- Nadia: final runbook review by Oct 10.
- Ben: dry run #2 in staging by Oct 9; order food for cutover night.
- Harriet: support macro for 'my points look wrong' by Oct 13.
- Sol: customer email copy, draft to legal by Oct 8.
- Farida: confirm dashboard alerts for the two rollback signals.

PARKING LOT / NOT DECIDED
- Whether support is told before or after the freeze starts (no owner yet).
- Renaming the service. Tabled again.
- Dashboard colors. Nobody cares enough.
- Dmitri asked by email whether we can do a partial cutover by region. Not discussed yet.

contexts.title: Platform weekly status - week of Sep 29
contexts.text:
PLATFORM WEEKLY STATUS - week of Sep 29
Compiled by Lionel Achterberg from team updates. Green = on track, Amber = at risk, Red = blocked.

1. SSO for the admin console - AMBER
Owner: Lionel Achterberg. SAML logins from Keyward fail for any user whose email address contains a plus sign. Root cause is on Keyward's side (their support case 88213). Workaround for affected admins: password login plus TOTP, allowed until SSO ships. New ETA Oct 9; the previous ETA was Oct 2.

2. Billing export to the finance warehouse - GREEN
Owner: Mei-Lin Castell. The nightly export has run 14 nights in a row without a gap. Next step is adding the credit-note table.

3. Search reindex - DONE
Owner: Arjun Pallister. Reindex finished Sep 26; query p95 is back under 300 ms.

4. Audit log retention - RED
Owner: Mei-Lin Castell. Blocked until we know how long audit logs must be kept for enterprise customers. Question sent Sep 17; no answer recorded yet.

5. Staging cluster upgrade - GREEN
Owner: Arjun Pallister. Node pools upgraded. The production upgrade is scheduled for Oct 21, pending the change board.

6. Hiring
One backend req open. Two onsites next week. Interview panels are set; Mei-Lin and Arjun are on both.

7. On-call
Quiet week: 4 pages, all for the flaky disk alert on the batch hosts. Arjun raised the alert threshold; watch it for another week before closing the ticket.

8. Tooling
CI minutes are up 18% month over month, mostly from the new integration suite. Lionel will look at caching after SSO ships. The old Jenkins box is scheduled for shutdown at the end of October.

RISKS
- If Keyward slips again, the SSO launch lands inside the Oct 15 freeze and has to wait until after it.
- Arjun is out Oct 6-10; Mei-Lin covers staging questions while he is away.

KUDOS
- Mei-Lin for chasing down the duplicate invoices in the export.
- Support for the quick turnaround on the plus-sign workaround doc.

contexts.title: Data platform sync - running notes
contexts.text:
DATA PLATFORM SYNC - RUNNING NOTES
Shared doc, newest entries at the bottom. Please don't delete old entries.

Sep 16
- Warehouse migration from the old Redshift cluster to the new lakehouse is a go.
- Code freeze for warehouse schemas: Oct 14.
- Backfill of historical orders (2019-2024): owner Priya Raman.
- Plan is two dry runs before the real backfill.
- Tomasz raised the question of whether finance's month-end reports can run during the freeze.
- Gwen reminded everyone that the old cluster's reserved-instance contract ends in December, so there is no appetite for slipping past that.
- Dashboards for row counts and checksum comparison: Marcus to build a first version.

Sep 23
- Vendor contract for the new storage tier signs a week late, so the freeze moves to Oct 21.
- Priya moves over to the ingestion rewrite. Marcus Oduya takes over the backfill starting this week.
- Three dry runs now, since the first one surfaced a timezone bug in the 2021 data.
- Tomasz to confirm the finance reports question with Gwen.

Sep 30
- Dry run #1 re-done after the timezone fix; looks clean. 11 hours end to end.
- Tomasz: finance reports are fine as long as they read from the snapshot.
- Reminder that everything must be merged before the freeze.
- Checksum dashboard is live but only covers 2022 onward; older years still need a manual spot check.
- Someone please fix the calendar invite for this meeting, it still points at the old room.
- Next sync moves to Tuesday because of the holiday on Monday.

ACTION ITEMS (carried over, please update)
- Priya: backfill dry run #2 by Friday.
- Marcus: ingestion rewrite design doc.
- All: freeze Oct 14, get your schema changes in.
- Tomasz: book the war room for backfill weekend.
contexts.notes: Contradictions: schema freeze Oct 14 (Sep 16 entry and the carried-over action items) vs Oct 21 (Sep 23 entry); backfill owner Priya Raman (Sep 16 entry and action items) vs Marcus Oduya (Sep 23 entry); the action items also swap Priya and Marcus onto each other's work; number of dry runs two (Sep 16) vs three (Sep 23).

contexts.title: Office move - facilities notes
contexts.text:
OFFICE MOVE - FACILITIES NOTES
From: Workplace team. Move weekend: Nov 7-9.

- Everyone on floor 4 moves to the east half of floor 6. Desk booking switches to the new floor plan on Nov 10.
- Pack personal items in the crates delivered Nov 3. Label every crate with your name and new desk number; unlabeled crates go to storage.
- Monitors, docks and chairs stay with the desks. Do not pack them.
- The floor 6 kitchen gets a second dishwasher and a bigger fridge. Fridge clear-out every Friday at 4 pm, no exceptions.
- Quiet room bookings max out at 2 hours.
- Bike storage moves to the basement level B1; badge access is updated automatically.
- Plants: the facilities team will move shared plants. Personal plants are your responsibility.
- Parking permits do not change; the garage entrance stays on Alder Street.
- Questions go to the workplace channel, not to individual facilities staff.
